# Thematiq

> Thematiq is an open-source theming app for the Nextcloud workspace.

Thematiq is an open-source theming app for the Nextcloud workspace. Administrators pick a theme from more than 60 ready-made themes (Rijkshuisstijl, Gemeente Utrecht, Amsterdam, Den Haag, Rotterdam, and more) or create their own, and the workspace adopts that brand identity instantly. A token editor lets teams fine-tune individual colours, and customisations export to a file for sharing across instances. Released under EUPL-1.2 and maintained by Conduction since 2019.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://thematiq.conduction.nl/docs/): main entry, including tutorials, user guide, and admin guide.
- [API reference](https://thematiq.conduction.nl/api): OpenAPI documentation.

## Optional

- [Install](https://www.conduction.nl/install): self-host on your Nextcloud instance.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ConductionNL/thematiq): repository and issue tracker.
- [App page](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/thematiq): product positioning on conduction.nl.
